children.title: How to Write a Logline — TV Writing & Development Course: Ep4
children.description: A clear introduction to writing strong loglines, focusing on how to craft a compelling one-sentence summary that captures your story’s core idea and helps your script stand out in pitches and development.

children.title: Start Your Short Film in 3 Easy Steps
children.description: Khaila Amazan, writer behind the short film 'The Spider Within' shares her tips to newcomer writers to get started on their short film.

children.title: Intro to Storyboarding
children.description: An overview of storyboarding basics, explaining how boards help plan shots, edits, and communicate vision to a team, including common formats, styles, and practical alternatives for non-drawers.

children.title: 12 SHOTS That Make EVERYTHING CINEMATIC
children.description: An introduction to 12 essential shot types that strengthen visual storytelling, covering foundational cinematography techniques useful for both beginners and experienced filmmakers.

children.title: Filmmaking 101: 5 Camera Angles Every Director Must Know
children.description: A masterclass on five essential camera angles and three core viewing perspectives, explaining how camera placement and framing shape emotion, tension, and cinematic storytelling across different film styles.

children.title: Lighting 101: Intro to Light Placement
children.description: An introduction to the fundamentals of three-point lighting, explaining the roles and placement of key, fill, and backlight, and demonstrating how this classic setup enhances depth, separation, and cinematic quality.

children.title: Roger Deakins on Location Scouting for Film — Cinematography Techniques Ep. 5
children.description: A breakdown of professional location scouting through insights from Roger Deakins, covering pre-visualization, problem-solving on real productions, practical workflow tips, and considerations for both large and small-scale films.
